top_violation_types.title: Required Immunizations Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current (26 TAC §747.613(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The immunization record for one child was not up to date.

top_violation_types.title: Children's Records - Admission Information (26 TAC §747.603(a)(2))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: There was no admission information available for children in care.

top_violation_types.title: Children's Records - Health Statement (26 TAC §747.603(a)(3))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One child is missing a health statement.

top_violation_types.title: Time Period of Training - Primary Caregiver (26 TAC §747.1311(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The caregiver did not have trainings for last completed training year.

top_violation_types.title: Records Maintained and Made Available - Safety Drills Documentation (26 TAC §747.801(7))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: There was no documentation of fire safety emergency drills, fire extinguisher checks, smoke detector checks, and carbon monoxide detector testing made available for review during the inspection.

top_violation_types.title: Written Activity Plan - Develop and Follow (26 TAC §747.2102(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation does not have a written activity plan.

top_violation_types.title: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes (26 TAC §744.3559(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: There was not a record of monthly fire drills conducted for licensing to review.

top_violation_types.title: Prohibited Punishments - Humiliating, Rejecting, Yelling (26 TAC §744.2105(5))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The caregiver yelled at the children, instructing them to remain silent and keep still.
